# Avenquell Studio

Website: https://avenquell.com
Based in Charleston, South Carolina. Works with brands worldwide.

## What the studio does

Avenquell is a creative and marketing studio for brands that want a diagnosis before they
spend more on production or ads. The order is deliberate: direction before production,
diagnosis before spend.

Most studios sell output. Avenquell starts by establishing what is actually wrong — with the
visuals, with the ads, or with the measurement underneath them — states it in writing, and
only then builds. AI is used as a production tool; human direction decides what gets produced,
and a person reviews every asset before delivery.

## How an engagement works

Three stages. A client can enter at any of them.

1. Diagnose — a paid diagnostic that names the problem in writing and defines the production
   scope with fixed pricing.
2. Fix — one project, scoped after the diagnosis, with the price locked before production starts.
3. Grow — monthly systems for brands that need consistent creative and marketing output.

## The Method

Six steps with two client approval gates:

1. Brief intake — brand context, goals, product details and use cases, documented.
2. Brand direction — the visual world is written down and approved before anything is produced.
   This is an approval gate; production does not begin until it is signed off.
3. Visual system map — every asset is assigned a use case before production.
4. Production — AI-assisted, run against the approved direction rather than guessed prompts.
5. Human review — a person checks brand accuracy, consistency, use-case fit and product
   accuracy against the approved direction. This is the second gate. Nothing ships without it.
6. Delivery and iteration — assets organised by use case and channel. One round of revisions
   is included; a change of direction or scope is quoted separately.

## The Standard

What the studio refuses to deliver: random generations untied to an approved direction,
off-brand output, distorted product details, the glossy default AI look, unsupported beauty
or efficacy claims, unrealistic fabric and skin textures, unlimited revisions, and anything
that has not passed human review.

## Diagnostics

Premium Visual Audit — $1,500 or $2,500. Three business days from complete inputs.
A paid visual diagnostic for brands that need direction before production. Both tiers review
the current visual system and define a production scope with fixed pricing. The $2,500 tier
adds a read of the client's own post and ad creative stats, connecting what the visuals do to
how people responded. The $1,500 tier works from a brief the client fills in. No account
access is required for either.

Ad Diagnostic — $3,500. Five business days from a complete upload.
For brands whose ad spend is running without results following. Traces the path from ad to
lead and finds where it breaks, including whether the measurement is real: whether conversions
are set to a button click instead of a real submission, whether calls are counted, whether
sources are tagged, whether spend is chasing duplicated events. Ranks what to fix first and
includes 3-5 ad concepts built around the diagnosis. Works from campaign exports, analytics
exports and screenshots of settings — no account access.
The report states plainly what cannot be verified without live access: whether a conversion
event actually fires on a real submission, true audience sizes, Conversions API signal quality,
pixel behaviour on live traffic, cross-domain tracking, and the history of settings changes.
Guarantee: the cause is named, or the fee is refunded. The disclosed unverifiable items are
excluded from refund scope and are stated before payment.
Not a fit if ads have been running less than two or three months — there is not enough history.

Marketing Research — $7,500 (two weeks) or $12,500 (four weeks).
For brands without their own data history. Maps buyers, their language, competitive position
and where the message needs to go. The $12,500 tier adds buyer interviews, analysis of existing
data and live message testing. Content and media planning are not included.

## Projects

Strategy & Positioning — from $5,000. Segments, competitors, positioning and offer, delivered
as a working document the client keeps.

Launch Creative Package — from $6,500, two to four weeks. For product launches, seasonal
campaigns, offer rollouts and campaign-ready asset systems.

## Monthly systems

Monthly Creative Content System — from $9,500/mo. Two-month minimum, then month to month.
Ongoing creative production, visual consistency and monthly campaign support without
rebuilding direction from zero each month.

Content Plan & Scripts — from $5,000/mo. A monthly content plan and scripts the client's team
publishes. Posting and community management are not included.

Analytics & Reporting — $2,500/mo. A monthly report built from the client's data exports.
Analytics setup is not included.

Quantitative & Segment Analytics — from $5,000, one-time. Who is actually buying and where the
best customers come from, analysed from client exports rather than direct database access.

Full Creative & Strategy System — $12,500/mo for one primary segment and channel, or
$18,000/mo for two to three segments, each with its own funnel and content plan. Paid media
management is not included.

## How pricing works

The diagnostic defines the scope — how many products, what source material exists, how many
characters and settings the work requires. Once agreed, the price is fixed in writing before
production starts. If scope changes, the price is recalculated against a published rate rather
than renegotiated, and the cost of a change is known before it is approved. No "starting from",
no mid-project adjustments.

The diagnostic fee is credited against the next project if the client moves forward within two
weeks of receiving the report. Applying the credit closes the refund guarantee; the two are
mutually exclusive.

## Terms

No annual contract. No platform fee. No prepayment for the year. Cancel with 30 days notice,
by email. The Monthly Creative Content System runs on a two-month minimum; other monthly
services run on a three-month minimum. Ad budgets are paid directly to the platforms, not
through the studio. All ad and analytics accounts are created in the client's own company name,
and the studio names the person running them.

## Verticals

DTC fashion and apparel. Beauty and skincare, with product accuracy built into the process.
Boutique hospitality — hotels, restaurants and experience-driven brands. Wellness and
supplements, kept to the boundary between aesthetics and efficacy claims.

## What the studio does not claim

Avenquell does not guarantee sales, ROAS, followers, bookings or performance, and states this
on its services page. Beauty and skincare visuals are editorial, not clinical: ingredient
results, before-and-afters and clinical language stay with the client's formulary and legal
team.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Avenquell do?
It diagnoses what is broken in a brand's visuals, ads or measurement, states it in writing, and
then builds what the diagnosis defined — from single projects to monthly creative systems.

Where do I start?
Most engagements start with a diagnostic: the Premium Visual Audit if the question is about
visuals and direction, the Ad Diagnostic if ad spend is running without results, and Marketing
Research if there is no data history yet.

Do you need access to my ad accounts?
No. Diagnostics work from exports and screenshots the client sends. The report states which
findings cannot be verified without live access.

How fast is a diagnostic?
Three business days for the Premium Visual Audit and five for the Ad Diagnostic, counted from
the point all required inputs have been received.

Is there a long-term contract?
No. There is no annual contract and no prepayment for the year. The Monthly Creative Content
System has a two-month minimum; other monthly services have a three-month minimum. Either ends
with 30 days notice.

Do you use AI?
Yes, as a production tool. Direction is decided by people, and every asset is reviewed by a
person against the approved direction before delivery.

Can I see your work?
The published pieces are concept studies: full launch directions built to show how the method
works — direction, production logic, asset systems and use-case mapping. They are labelled as
concept studies on the site.
